title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Thirty Madison is now part of Remedy! You can read more about the acquisition here. We are excited to join forces and continue to revolutionize healthcare accessibility!

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer within our centralized data team to own a core area of our data, such as financial performance, operations, or growth and retention, from raw sources through to the metrics leadership uses to make decisions. You'll build the dbt models and semantic layer behind those metrics. You'll also act as the analytical partner to the teams that rely on them.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean team that moves fast. Requirements often start ambiguous, and you'll be expected to find the highest-value problems before they reach anyone's roadmap.

Our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and Hex

Comp | Perks | Benefits


The base pay range for this role is $160,000-$180,000
Potential to earn equity
Robust and affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision plan options
Flexible time off policy
Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.


What you get to do every day


Own a functional data area. Be the lead analyst for a domain like finance or growth and retention, the first person stakeholders turn to for answers and insight. You'll own its models, metrics, analysis and roadmap.
Architect core data models. Design and maintain silver and gold layer models in dbt using Kimball dimensional modeling (facts and dimensions). These power segmentation, targeting, automation and analytics for your area.
Define and operationalize metrics. Turn company-wide metrics into governed, consistent definitions. Examples include retention, funnel conversion, LTV/CAC/ROAS and revenue.
Steward the semantic layer. Treat our BI tooling (Hex) as a product. Own semantic layer health, cross-team modeling standards and self-serve data products, beyond building dashboards on request.
Make the numbers trustworthy. Set standards for testing, documentation and freshness. Lead root-cause analysis on data discrepancies, then fix the underlying architecture so they don't recur.
Partner with the business. Turn ambiguous questions from Marketing, Growth, Finance and Product into clear requirements and scalable solutions. Work without dedicated PM support and use data to influence decisions.
Communicate clearly. Explain technical decisions, trade-offs and results to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. Set and manage expectations along the way.
Improve upstream data. Work with product and engineering on event taxonomy, instrumentation quality and consistency across app, web and backend.


What you bring to the role


5+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering or a closely related role.
Deep SQL in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. You use it to validate data quality, investigate anomalies and back your own analysis.
Production experience with dbt: modeling, testing, documentation and project structure.
Strong data modeling skills, including Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) and layered medallion architectures. You know when to break the rules.
Business and analytical judgment. You can tell which question matters and how to answer it, not just how to model it.
A track record of leading cross-team data initiatives, including gathering requirements yourself from technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Clear, confident communication with senior leadership, including pushing back and resetting expectations when needed.
Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You prioritize well and ship without waiting for perfect specs.
Hustle and a bias for action. You roll up your sleeves, do what the moment needs, whether that's a quick ad-hoc pull or a weekend fire drill on a broken pipeline, and follow through until it's done.


Bonus Points


Experience supporting Marketing, Growth, Sales or Product teams, such as attribution, paid media, funnels or retention.
Experience owning a BI platform or semantic layer (Hex, Looker, dbt Semantic Layer or similar) as a product.
Experience building semantic layers and documentation designed for AI and agentic workflows.
Familiarity with product analytics instrumentation and event tracking.
Background in consumer health, subscription or e-commerce businesses.


U.S. Applicants Only

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Remedy we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Contact us at recruiting@thirtymadison.com to request accommodation.

*This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 Form information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.*


Please be aware that there are fraudulent entities who are falsely claiming to be or represent Remedy in order to solicit sensitive personal information or payment. Remedy is not in any way associated with these entities or practices. The safety and integrity of those seeking employment with us is of the utmost importance and we actively work with our legal and security teams to prevent future incidents.


Remedy will never ask for sensitive information or payment when engaging with job seekers. The entities use many methods to perpetuate these scams, including but not limited to: participating in a text-only interview, using Remedy's trademarks on their correspondence, or providing you with a seemingly legitimate offer letter. If you suspect you are a victim of this scamming, we encourage you to cease further contact and report the crime to The Federal Trade Commission.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
About FINNY

FINNY is a growth platform for financial advisors. We are on a mission to make great financial advice easier to find. Today, access to quality financial guidance is limited, not because advisors don't exist, but because the right connections are hard to make when it matters. We're fixing that with AI-powered tools that help advisors find, engage, and retain the clients they can genuinely help.

We've raised a $4.5M Seed from Y-Combinator in S24 and now $17M Series A led by Venrock. We work with over 1,000 firms across the wealth management ecosystem, and have been recognized as the leader in fintech innovation—winning #1 at the Morningstar Fintech Showcase, #1 at 2026 Wealthies, and being featured across the industry.

We're based in Chelsea, NYC, building fast and ambitious systems at the intersection of data, AI, and real-world wealth services.

About The Team

You'll join FINNY Engineering and report to our VP of Engineering. The team today is product and backend engineers and a data team. You'll be our first analytics engineer, building the foundation of the company's analytics warehouse on dbt Core and Snowflake.

About The Role

FINNY is a metrics-driven company. Until now, our analytics warehouse has been a shared role, divided across several teams. We're bringing it together in a new structure, on a new foundation, and we're hiring a senior Analytics Engineer to own it end to end: the models, the definitions of the metrics the company runs on, and the reports people trust.

You'll work directly with operations, sales, marketing, growth strategy, finance, product and engineering. Success looks like: the metrics the company runs on have tested definitions, a small set of reports is the first place people look, AI tools answer questions about those metrics correctly, and every key business area is covered to the same standard. As the data team grows, you'll help hire and lead it.

What You’ll Do


Own the analytics warehouse day to day: staging and core models, dimensions, facts and identity resolution across our systems
Define the metrics FINNY runs on, with tests and documentation, so every team works from the same numbers
Partner with internal stakeholders across the company to turn their questions into models and reports they use
Own the BI layer: choose the tool and semantic layer, and keep a small set of authoritative reports
Make the warehouse something AI tools can answer from correctly
Run the dbt project like software: version control, code review, CI, tests and documentation


What We’re Looking For


Typically 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or analytics, including owning models that other teams relied on
Strong SQL and dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, conformed keys, and a clear grain for every table
dbt (or an equivalent tool) in production, with git, tests and CI
You've defined business metrics people used to make decisions, and fixed the cause when two numbers disagreed
You work directly with non-technical partners and turn vague questions into clear answers—and say "not yet" with a reason
Scrappy, with ownership: you jump in where help is needed, including work outside your job description
You're excited to work in person, 5 days a week, in our Chelsea, NYC office


Nice To Have


First or early data hire at a startup
Modeled complex pricing, billing, subscription or usage data
Made data usable by AI agents: documentation, a semantic layer, guardrails
Event analytics (PostHog or similar) and CRM data


Compensation & Benefits

FINNY offers a competitive compensation package including:


Competitive salary and equity
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible paid time off
401(k)
Food and meals provided in our NYC office
Team offsites and events


Equal Opportunity Employer

description:

Outtake exists to empower and facilitate trust for a digital-first world. Today, impersonation, fraud, AI-driven scams, and identity abuse spread faster than any security team can respond to. Built by ex-Palantir, ex-CTO/founders, and ex-Notion engineers, Outtake is designed for clarity, autonomy, and velocity. Our goal is ambitious: become the trust layer of the modern internet. And we intend to do it with a lean, dense, exceptionally talented team.

Outtake is backed by top-tier investors and operators who believe in our mission and our model. With strong financial footing and a long runway, we prioritize creating an environment where people can do the best work of their careers.

The Role

This is a Founding Applied Data Scientist role. You will define how Outtake understands, measures, and improves the performance of our product, business, and AI systems, building the data foundation that turns messy product usage, customer outcomes, model behavior, and business operations into clear decisions and durable systems.

Our product operates in a noisy, adversarial, fast-moving threat landscape. You will make legible what is working, where our agents are succeeding or failing, how customers are experiencing value, and how the business should price, package, and prioritize its work. The role begins as an individual contributor position; the desire to eventually hire, mentor, and scale a high-performing data function will be valuable as the function grows.

This is not a narrow reporting or dashboarding role. You will shape the semantic layer, define canonical metrics, build the analytical infrastructure, influence product and pricing decisions, and set the long-term bar for how Outtake uses data as the company scales — operating comfortably at the intersection of analytics engineering, applied data science, product strategy, and AI systems evaluation.

What You’ll Do


Own our analytical data pipeline and infrastructure across product, business, and AI performance data.
Build and own the long-term roadmap for data infrastructure, analytics, and applied data science at Outtake.
Define and maintain the semantic layer in our product analytics stack, including Hex and the underlying warehouse models.
Build canonical performance metrics for our product and business, including activation, usage, retention, customer value, operational efficiency, and agent effectiveness.
Partner with Product and Finance to refine pricing models, usage-based packaging, margin analysis, and customer-level profitability.
Work with Platform Engineering on internal AI performance metrics, evals, benchmarking, observability, and reliability reporting.
Design dashboards, analyses, and decision-support systems that help the team make fast, high-confidence product and business decisions.
Build data quality checks, documentation, and metric definitions that make our data trustworthy and easy for others to use.
Translate ambiguous questions from product, GTM, finance, and engineering into rigorous analyses and practical recommendations.
As the data function matures, we expect to grow this into a broader team with dedicated ownership across analytics engineering, AI evaluation, and business intelligence.


What We’re Looking For


5+ years of combined experience as an Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Scientist, or closely related role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, ideally with production experience in Postgres and modern analytical modeling patterns.
Experience building reliable data pipelines, data models, semantic layers, or internal analytics infrastructure.
Experience defining product and business metrics from first principles, not just reporting on pre-existing dashboards.
Experience working with modern AI eval frameworks, model performance measurement, LLM observability, or similar systems.
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business or product questions into clear analytical approaches.
Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM stakeholders.
The ability to communicate complex analyses clearly, including the tradeoffs, caveats, and recommendations that matter.
High ownership, a strong bias toward action, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.
Nice to have: experience working with Hex or similar collaborative analytics tools.
Nice to have: experience as an early data hire or founding team member in a high-growth startup.
Nice to have: experience working with Langfuse, Braintrust, Arize, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, or similar AI observability/eval tooling.
Nice to have: experience working with ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, DuckDB, dbt, or similar analytical data systems.
Nice to have: experience with usage-based pricing, unit economics, margin modeling, or customer-level profitability analysis.
Nice to have: experience building metrics or evals for AI agents, LLM products, fraud systems, abuse detection, cybersecurity, or trust & safety products.
Nice to have: experience building internal tools, notebooks, or lightweight apps that help non-data teammates answer their own questions.


Life at Outtake

Health: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for employees.

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As Architect for the Global Technology Global Sales Reporting group, you will be responsible for the technical design, implementation and ongoing operation of our global SAMIS Data Warehouse / DataLake. Large volumes of sales consumption data are ingested into this environment from various up-stream systems within cloud-based architectures. Users from various department gain strategic business insights from this data using the SAMIS Frontend.

What You'll Do


Transform the SAMIS architectural strategy into working code: Own the implementation of the end-to-end data lifecycle (Ingestion, Processing, Storage, APIs, Enablement, Security/Sharing) . You will personally write critical path code for new ingestion connectors and API services.
Code and enforce SAMIS development standards: Write the first versions of SAMIS coding templates, CI/CD workflows, and data quality frameworks. You will actively participate in design reviews and critical code review, submitting Pull Requests comments and alternative code snippets.
Deliver automated reporting by building the data marts: Engage directly with business teams and other tech leads (Operation, Sales) to understand their KPIs. Design, build, and optimize the actual SAMIS aggregate tables and materialized views that power their dashboards, ensuring sub-second query performance.
Align SAMIS releases with source upstream and downstream system: Work with System Owners, but at the API/Schema level. You will personally inspect upstream data workflows, write schema-validation scripts, and build automated alerting for when source systems introduce breaking changes.
Perform hands-on design and code walkthroughs: Sit with architects and project leads, reviewing not just high-level designs but actual Python/SQL/Java code/Agentic AI Pluginy. You will refactor problematic modules and help junior engineers through pair-programming sessions on complex SAMIS transformation logic.
Run Targeted POCs for SAMIS: Own the end-to-end execution of POCs for new SAMIS components and features (e.g., GoldenGate, Data Flow, Autonomous DB, New Lakehouse developments). You will set up the test environments, write the integration code, benchmark performance, and present your technical findings back to the Senior Leads for a final review.
Run weekly SAMIS technical working sessions: Facilitate deep-dive meetings with leads and architects, actively contribute code-level feedback, whiteboard solutions, and write proof-of-concept scripts on the fly to resolve technical issues.
Code the SAMIS release management strategy: Coordinate with DevOps to build and maintain the actual CI/CD YAML pipelines. You will define the deployment strategies and personally oversee production releases, performing rollbacks when necessary.
Get hands-on with OCI infrastructure stack: Partner with the OCI CloudOps team, debug Spark cluster configurations, rewrite inefficient SQL queries, and tune AIDP to cut pipeline runtimes
Implement InfoSec requirements in the codebase: Collaborate with InfoSec, but then translate their policies into actual implementations, writing row-level security filters, setting up encryption key rotations, and embedding dynamic data masking directly into SAMIS API queries.
Drive SAMIS cost optimization through code refactoring: Work with Tech Leads and OCICloudOps, rewriting expensive table scans, implementing partition pruning strategies, and moving cold data to cheaper storage tiers directly via code, while reporting monthly savings metrics from a technical level
Help build SAMIS operational resilience from the ground up: Leverage your hands-on production experience to design and implement the full operational framework for SAMIS. Monitoring dashboards (e.g., Grafana/OCI Monitoring), define granular alerting rules based on pipeline SLAs, document comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures for recurring failure scenarios, and work on the automation fixes.


Who You Are


OCI ecosystem: Autonomous DB, AI Data Platform, Data Integration, Unified Catalog, Analytic Views, ORDS, Data Flow, Object Storage, OCI Events/Functions
Lakehouse: Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with Iceberg and Delta Uniform—ACID, time travel, schema evolution, and compaction
Data modeling: Star schema, snowflake, and dimensional modeling for analytical performance
Lakehouse strategies: Batch vs. incremental ingestion, partitioning, lifecycle management, and handling late-arriving data
Processing & orchestration: ETL/ELT tools, Spark (batch + streaming), and exposure to Agentic AI Workflows for self-healing pipelines
Languages: Expert in Python, PySpark, SQL; comfortable with performance tuning in Spark UI

Description

Duties Description

The New York State Office of Information Technology Services (ITS) provides operational support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days of the year, supporting more than 4,900 applications for 53 New York State Agencies.

Under the direction of a Manager of Information Technology Services 1, the Technology Analyst 1 (AI), SG-23, will design, build, integrate, and validate new AI platforms, applications, and developer capabilities within AI Platform Engineering.

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:


Translate approved requirements for seven defined projects into technical designs, delivery backlogs, development tasks, and acceptance criteria: GCP Secure AI Lab, AWS Secure AI Lab, Azure Secure AI Lab, AI Farm, FinOps Product, Kiro Enterprise, and RAG Application.
Design, code, integrate, and test secure applications using Python, C#, .NET, PowerShell, and SQL as appropriate to each project; build application interfaces, database schemas, APIs, and automated deployment pipelines.
Build the GCP Secure AI Lab release against the SAIL BRD, including Terraform provisioning, federated access, Cloud Workstations, collaborative notebooks, approved AI services, and test-data workflows. Implement and validate network isolation, controlled egress, sensitive-data protection, model safeguards, logging, and budget controls.
Design and build AWS and Azure Secure AI Lab implementations, establishing provider-specific infrastructure-as-code, identity, network, developer-tool, and governance integrations. Validate repeatable deployment and approved security boundaries before acceptance.
Build AI Farm capabilities for in-house model development and training, including approved data preparation, reproducible training pipelines, experiment tracking, model evaluation, versioned artifacts, and documented release criteria.
Develop the FinOps Product as an in-house application for monitoring financial operations within CTO and ITS. Implement approved data integrations, validation and reconciliation logic, role-based financial reporting, and user-facing analysis capabilities.
Build Kiro Enterprise enablement tooling for MCP registry publication and validation, license-utilization and right-sizing reports, usage telemetry integrations, and repeatable AWS account configuration. Test the new tooling and integrations against approved enterprise requirements.
Develop the RAG Application, including document ingestion, retrieval, application interfaces, and access controls. Build approved source integrations and automated evaluation workflows; validate retrieval quality, security, and performance against agreed acceptance criteria.
Build reusable platform automation and project integrations with enterprise systems, including Active Directory, SCCM, System Center Orchestrator, databases, and approved cloud services where required by the solution design.
Implement DevSecOps and MLOps delivery pipelines, automated tests, and release controls. Conduct integration, security, performance, and user acceptance testing; correct defects identified during project validation.
Produce architecture diagrams, source code, infrastructure definitions, test evidence, deployment instructions, and knowledge-transfer materials for each completed build. Coordinate release acceptance and transfer completed capabilities to designated service owners.
Coordinate project dependencies and delivery reviews with the Manager of Information Technology Services 1, stakeholders, developers, and security and infrastructure teams. Follow applicable NYS laws, ITS policies, and approved engineering standards throughout design and delivery.

Five (5) years of information technology experience, one (1) year of which must be within the discipline of artificial intelligence.

Substitutions


Associate’s degree with 15 semester credit hours in computer science or a related field substitutes for one year of general information technology experience.

Bachelor’s degree in any field substitutes for two (2) years of general information technology experience.
Master’s degree or higher in computer science or related field substitutes for one year of general information technology experience.

Appointment to this position and continued employment with the agency is contingent upon obtaining and/or maintaining New York State residency within six months of hiring.
Appointment to this position is not final until all agency approvals have been granted.

Active practitioner of AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini or equivalent) as daily workflow.

Experience with AWS Control Tower, Account Factory for Terraform (AFT), or custom account vending.
Hands-on chaos engineering: AWS FIS, Gremlin, or equivalent Game Day experience.
Experience building agentic pipelines or AI-integrated developer tooling.
Familiarity with Slack platform development, Bolt SDK, or ChatOps automation.
Background in FinOps, Policy-as-Code (Sentinel, OPA), or secrets management (Vault).

Risk Mitigation: Natural skepticism toward complexity; you find single points of failure before they find you.
